summary: Verified Windows-pinned backend (requirements-windows.txt) running on http://127.0.0.1:8002 with resolved newer libs (pydantic 2.14.1 / pydantic_core 2.50.1 / pymongo 4.18.3 / motor 3.7.1 / bcrypt 5.0.0 / watchfiles 1.3.0, uvicorn 0.25.0, fastapi 0.110.1). 17/17 pytest cases pass: login (admin@erp.com / Admin@123) with Origin: http://localhost:8002 returns 200 and sets httpOnly Secure access/refresh cookies; /api/auth/me 200; 10 read endpoints — /api/items?lite=1, /api/items, /api/crm/quotations, /api/purchase-orders, /api/production, /api/work-orders, /api/bom, /api/customers, /api/suppliers, /api/dashboard/stats — all 200 and JSON-serialisable with no ObjectId leakage; items CRUD round-trip (POST→PUT→GET verify→DELETE→GET 404) OK; POST /api/items {} returns 422 (not 500); bcrypt 5 verified end-to-end via PUT /api/users/{admin_id} password change + re-login + revert. /tmp/srv8002.log contains 0 tracebacks/errors over the whole run (74 lines, only INFO access logs). Static review of windows/setup.bat and pyinfo.py: no concrete bugs. requirements-windows.txt covers every third-party import found in server.py + core/*.py.
critical_code_review_comments: windows/setup.bat looks correct: CRLF confirmed (file(1) → 'with CRLF line terminators'), setlocal EnableDelayedExpansion at line 2 so !PYVER! works, cd /d %ROOT% runs before any relative paths (windows\pyinfo.py, backend\venv\Scripts\python.exe), nested for/if parses in cmd, `tokens=1,2 delims=|` with %%P implicitly binds %%Q to the second token (documented cmd behaviour), `!PYVER:~2! lss 10` is a valid numeric compare in cmd (11 lss 10 = false, 9 lss 10 = true), venv-version mismatch triggers rmdir + recreate, pip uses --only-binary=:all: so missing wheels fail fast with a clear hint. No stray '(' or ')' appear inside echo text within parenthesised blocks.
windows/pyinfo.py: single print of `<executable>|<major.minor>` — correct, no newline issues on Windows (print adds \n which cmd for-/f strips).

requirements-windows.txt covers all third-party imports found in server.py + core/*.py: fastapi, starlette, uvicorn, httpx (used in gstin lookup), pydantic (+ EmailStr → email-validator), motor + pymongo (+ bson), bcrypt, PyJWT (import jwt), python-dotenv, python-multipart (UploadFile/File/Form), openpyxl, playwright. Pure-Python packages are pinned; compiled packages (pydantic_core, pymongo, motor, bcrypt, watchfiles, greenlet) use lower-bound ranges so pip can pick a wheel for Python 3.11-3.15. On this pod pip picked pydantic 2.14.1 / pydantic_core 2.50.1 / pymongo 4.18.3 / motor 3.7.1 / bcrypt 5.0.0 and server.py import + full API surface works unchanged.

Nit (not a bug): if `python` on PATH resolves to the Microsoft Store stub (not a real install), the fallback at line 20 will still succeed in printing exe|ver but `python -m venv` can create a store-managed venv — users are already guided by the existing warning at lines 23-24 to disable the App execution alias.
Nit (unchanged from prior iteration): server.py is 17.7k lines; still overdue for modular split.
